# 1078 - Multiplication Table

**Category:** Beginner

## Description

Read an integer N and print the multiplication table of N from 1 to 10.

## Input

The input contains an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 999).

## Output

Print the multiplication table of N, formatted as shown in the example.

## Example

| Input | Output |
|-------|--------|
| 140 | 140 x 1 = 140<br>140 x 2 = 280<br>140 x 3 = 420<br>140 x 4 = 560<br>140 x 5 = 700<br>140 x 6 = 840<br>140 x 7 = 980<br>140 x 8 = 1120<br>140 x 9 = 1260<br>140 x 10 = 1400 |

## RPython Features Used

- `input_int()` builtin for reading integers
- `val` for immutable variables
- `for` loop iterating over a list literal `[1, 2, 3, ..., 10]`
- Integer arithmetic (`*`)
- `print()` and `print_line()` for formatted output
